How Times Square connects

  • Location: Broadway theatre district — The Broadway theatre district is clustered around Times Square.
  • Topic: Broadway — Times Square is the lighted front door of Broadway.
  • Location: TKTS — The TKTS booth stands in Duffy Square at Times Square.

What is Times Square?

Times Square is the crossing of Broadway and Seventh that became the glowing front door of the theatre district, TKTS booth, and tourist crowd that feeds the nearby houses.
